name: Grain Carry Quintile Monotonicity Test
description: Quintile sort on corn (ZC) and soybean (ZS) futures carry using 252-day percentrank. Rank 1 = deepest contango (bottom 20%), Rank 5 = deepest backwardation (top 20%). Tests monotonicity: does higher carry quintile predict higher forward 63-day carry? Bar chart shows median forward carry by quintile. Summary table adds N, hit rate (sign persistence), median, and worst forward carry per quintile.
source:
# Grain Carry Quintile Monotonicity Test
# Does carry quintile rank predict forward carry? Q1=deepest contango, Q5=deepest backwardation
# 252-day percentrank for equal-population quintile buckets (S44 pattern)
# Forward carry via << 63 (NOT forward_returns — carry crosses zero, S46)

# --- Data ---
ts = index()().value
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

carry = cont.carry

# --- Forward carry (63 trading days ≈ 1 quarter) ---
fwd_carry_63 = carry << 63

# --- Quintile assignment via 252-day percentrank ---
# percentrank returns 0-100; map to quintiles 1-5
# Q1 = bottom 20% (deepest contango), Q5 = top 20% (deepest backwardation)
carry_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(carry)
quintile = conditional_select(
    is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank <= 20, 1.0,
    is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank <= 40, 2.0,
    is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank <= 60, 3.0,
    is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank <= 80, 4.0,
    is_valid(carry_pctrank) and carry_pctrank <= 100, 5.0,
    0.0
)

# --- Filter forward carry by quintile ---
has_fwd = is_valid(fwd_carry_63) and is_valid(carry_pctrank) and quintile > 0
q1_fwd = where(has_fwd and quintile == 1.0, fwd_carry_63)
q2_fwd = where(has_fwd and quintile == 2.0, fwd_carry_63)
q3_fwd = where(has_fwd and quintile == 3.0, fwd_carry_63)
q4_fwd = where(has_fwd and quintile == 4.0, fwd_carry_63)
q5_fwd = where(has_fwd and quintile == 5.0, fwd_carry_63)

# --- Hit rate: does forward carry keep the same sign as current carry? ---
# Q1-Q2 (contango): hit if fwd_carry < 0. Q4-Q5 (backwardation): hit if fwd_carry > 0. Q3: skip sign test.
q1_hit = where(has_fwd and quintile == 1.0, 1.0 if fwd_carry_63 < 0 else 0.0)
q2_hit = where(has_fwd and quintile == 2.0, 1.0 if fwd_carry_63 < 0 else 0.0)
q3_hit = where(has_fwd and quintile == 3.0, 1.0 if fwd_carry_63 > 0 else 0.0)
q4_hit = where(has_fwd and quintile == 4.0, 1.0 if fwd_carry_63 > 0 else 0.0)
q5_hit = where(has_fwd and quintile == 5.0, 1.0 if fwd_carry_63 > 0 else 0.0)

# --- Event markers: transitions into extreme quintiles (Q1 or Q5) ---
prev_quintile = quintile >> 1
enter_q1 = quintile == 1.0 and (prev_quintile != 1.0)
enter_q5 = quintile == 5.0 and (prev_quintile != 5.0)
is_extreme_entry = enter_q1 or enter_q5
regime_label = "Q1 Deep Contango" if enter_q1 else "Q5 Deep Backwardation"

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Extreme Quintile Entry',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Quintile', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(carry, regime_label, cont.c, is_extreme_entry)

# --- Chart 1: Bars — median forward carry by quintile (monotonicity test) ---
# If bars step up from Q1 to Q5, carry rank predicts forward carry
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does Carry Quintile Predict Forward Carry? (Monotonicity Test)',
    y_axis_label='Median Carry in 63 Trading Days',
    category='Carry Quintile Analysis',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Deep Contango)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2 (Contango)', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3 (Neutral)', color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4 (Backwardation)', color=Color.Cyan),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q5 (Deep Backwd.)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(q1_fwd, q2_fwd, q3_fwd, q4_fwd, q5_fwd))

# --- Chart 2: Summary table — quintile persistence stats ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Carry Quintile Forward Stats (63d)',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['N (Days)', 'Hit Rate (Sign Persists)', 'Median Fwd Carry', 'Worst Fwd Carry'],
        col_headers=['Q1 Contango', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5 Backwd.'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    category='Carry Quintile Analysis',
    order=0
)(q1_fwd, q2_fwd, q3_fwd, q4_fwd, q5_fwd, q1_hit, q2_hit, q3_hit, q4_hit, q5_hit, q1_fwd, q2_fwd, q3_fwd, q4_fwd, q5_fwd, q1_fwd, q2_fwd, q3_fwd, q4_fwd, q5_fwd)
